commands.comparator_per_movie: <py> tools/compare_motioncorr.py --ref-mrc CPU_ref/Movies/<M>.mrc --ref-star CPU_ref/Movies/<M>.star --test-mrc CUDA_<mode>/Movies/<M>.mrc --test-star CUDA_<mode>/Movies/<M>.star --gate relaxed --json-out <M>_<mode>_relaxed.json
commands.invocation_style: All three configurations processed the full 24-movie movies.star in ONE process each, so they are mutually consistent. init_random_generator(random_seed) is called per movie inside MotioncorrRunner::executeOwnMotionCorrection, so batched and per-movie invocations are equivalent; this was confirmed empirically (see readme_reproduction).

cuda_all_fftw.experimental_marker_in_logs: 24 of 24 movie logs; each with 1 global + 25 local FFTW CCF activations

runs.note_on_single_run_wall_times: These are single, unpaired runs recorded alongside the correctness runs. They are NOT a controlled timing result. An optional paired repeat was stopped after it queued behind another GPU job and is excluded.
